product_overview: MARKED is a bilingual e-commerce marketplace where visitors browse products, categories, brands, and vendor storefronts. Customers can manage a cart, checkout with sandbox payment, and track orders, while vendors and admins manage storefront operations and platform administration.
core_goals: Browse the product catalog by search, category, brand, and vendor
Register, log in, and manage a customer account
Add products to a persistent cart and complete checkout
View order history and cancel eligible orders
Help vendors manage products, orders, and commissions
Help admins manage users, vendors, catalog data, orders, payments, commissions, and site settings
Switch the interface between Arabic and English

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can register as customers or vendors, log in, and log out to access role-based areas of the marketplace.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in the registration form and choose a customer or vendor role -> Submit the form -> See account creation complete and proceed as an authenticated user
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated dashboard or homepage state
Navigate to /login -> Leave required fields invalid or incorrect -> Submit the login form -> See validation feedback or an invalid credentials message
Use the user menu after signing in -> Choose to log out -> See the signed-out state and public access only

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Visitors can search, filter, sort, paginate, and open product detail pages to inspect product information before purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Browse the product catalog -> Type a search keyword -> Apply category and brand filters -> Move through pagination -> See a refined product list
Navigate to /products -> Open a product card -> View the product detail page -> Inspect the gallery, price, rating, and stock information
Navigate to /products -> Change search or filter criteria -> Observe the product list update to match the selected catalog constraints

features.name: Category, Brand and Vendor Browsing
features.description: Visitors can explore marketplace structure through category pages, brand pages, and approved vendor storefronts.
user_flows: Navigate to /categories -> Browse the category list -> Open a category -> See products filtered by that category
Navigate to /brands -> Browse the brand list -> Open a brand -> See products filtered by that brand
Navigate to /vendors -> Browse approved vendor stores -> Open a vendor storefront -> See the vendor's products and store page information

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Authenticated customers can add products to a persistent cart and manage quantities before checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Open a product detail page -> Add the product to the cart -> Open /cart -> See the item in the cart
Navigate to /cart -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See the cart totals update
Navigate to /cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> See the item disappear and totals recalculate
Navigate to /cart -> Clear the cart -> See an empty cart state

features.name: Checkout and Sandbox Payment
features.description: Authenticated customers can place an order, provide shipping details, and complete a sandbox payment flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout with items already in the cart -> Fill in or select a shipping address -> Place the order -> Complete the sandbox payment step -> See the order confirmation
Navigate to /checkout with items already in the cart -> Review order details and shipping information -> Submit the checkout flow -> See the created order and payment simulation result

features.name: Customer Account and Orders
features.description: Customers can update their profile, change password, view order history, inspect order details, and cancel eligible orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /account -> Update the profile name and phone number -> Save changes -> See the updated account information
Navigate to /account -> Change the password -> Submit the update -> See the password change complete
Navigate to /account/orders -> Browse the order history -> Open an order detail -> See the full order information
Navigate to /account/orders/[id] -> Open a cancellable order -> Cancel the order -> See the order status change to cancelled
Navigate to /account/orders/[id] -> Open a non-cancellable order -> Attempt to cancel it -> See the cancellation prevented by the order state

features.name: Vendor Dashboard
features.description: Approved vendors can manage their store products, view store orders, and review commission earnings.
user_flows: Navigate to /vendor -> View store overview stats -> Open product management -> See the vendor product list
Navigate to /vendor/products/new -> Enter localized product details, price, stock, and image URL -> Submit the form -> See the new product added to the store
Navigate to /vendor/products -> Open an existing product -> Update product details -> Save changes -> See the updated product information
Navigate to /vendor/products -> Open an existing product -> Delete the product -> See the product removed from the vendor list
Navigate to /vendor/orders -> Browse store orders -> Update an order status -> See the order status reflect the change
Navigate to /vendor/commissions -> View the commission summary -> See earnings and commission records

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admins can oversee platform activity and manage users, vendors, catalog content, orders, payments, commissions, and site settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View KPI overview -> Open a management section -> See the relevant admin records
Navigate to /admin/vendors -> Review pending or approved vendors -> Approve, reject, or suspend a vendor -> See the vendor status update
Navigate to /admin/users -> Review user accounts -> Activate or suspend a user -> See the account status update
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Create or edit a category -> Save changes -> See the updated category list
Navigate to /admin/brands -> Create or edit a brand -> Save changes -> See the updated brand list
Navigate to /admin/products -> Review product records -> Create or edit a product -> See the catalog update
Navigate to /admin/orders -> Review orders -> Update an order status -> See the order status change
Navigate to /admin/payments -> Review payment records -> See the payments list
Navigate to /admin/commissions -> Review commission records -> See the commission summary
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Update site settings -> Save changes -> See the updated configuration

features.name: Localization
features.description: Users can switch the site between Arabic and English and browse the marketplace in the matching text direction.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use the language switcher -> Switch to Arabic -> See the interface render in RTL layout
Navigate to / -> Use the language switcher -> Switch to English -> See the interface render in LTR layout
Navigate through public pages after switching language -> Observe labels, navigation, and page content remain in the selected locale

routes.description: Home page with hero, featured categories and products
Product catalog with search, filters and pagination
Product detail page with gallery and add-to-cart
Checkout with address and sandbox payment

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register, login, logout, refresh session and change password with JWT + httpOnly refresh cookie
user_interactions: Fill email and password on login page
See validation errors and invalid credential message
Fill registration form choosing customer or vendor role

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Browse products with search, category/brand filters, sort and pagination
user_interactions: View gallery, price, rating and stock on detail page

features.name: Category, Brand and Vendor pages
features.description: List pages and detail pages for categories, brands and approved vendors
user_interactions: Click a category and view its products
Open brands list and a brand page
Open vendors list and a vendor storefront

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Authenticated users keep a persistent cart and manage quantities
user_interactions: Add product to cart from product detail
See totals and continue to checkout

features.name: Checkout and Sandbox Payment
features.description: Place an order with address selection and simulate a sandbox payment
user_interactions: Open checkout with products in cart
Simulate sandbox payment on the payment page

features.name: Customer Account and Orders
features.description: Profile update and order history with detail and cancellation

features.name: Vendor Dashboard
features.description: Vendors manage their store, products, orders and commissions
user_interactions: Create a product with localized name, price and stock
View store orders and update their status

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Admins manage users, vendors, products, categories, brands, orders, payments, commissions and settings
user_interactions: Create or edit categories, brands and products
View payments, commissions and site settings

features.name: Localization
features.description: Full Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) UI with locale switcher and server-side i18n dictionaries
user_interactions: Browse the site in Arabic RTL layout
Browse the site in English LTR layout

known_limitations.issue: Images are URL strings only; no file upload backend exists
known_limitations.impact: Vendors and admins must paste external image URLs

known_limitations.issue: Payment is a sandbox simulation; no real gateway integration
known_limitations.impact: Payments are simulated, no real money movement

known_limitations.issue: Live dev tunnel may be slower for external image loads (picsum.photos)
known_limitations.impact: Product images may load slowly during cloud test runs
